chunks: 493 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام that he said:
"There is no harm in placing the man in front and the woman behind, or placing the woman in front and the man behind."
Meaning: in the funeral prayer for the deceased.
And the best position in the prayer over the deceased is the last row, and the reason for that is that women used to mix with men in the funeral prayer.

key_terms.الصَّفُّ الْآخِرُ: the last row, described here as the preferred position
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ: the funeral prayer offered over the deceased
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or funeral context
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; indicates permissibility
key_terms.يُقَدَّمَ: to be placed forward or in front

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the positioning of men and women in salat over the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith states that in the funeral prayer, there is no problem whether the man is placed in front and the woman behind, or the woman in front and the man behind. It also states that the preferred place in the funeral prayer is the last row, with the reason given being the mixing of women and men during the funeral prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.493 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

"There is no harm in placing the man in front and the woman behind or in placing the woman in front and the man behind"
[AL SADUQ]
This is referring to the arrangement of the funeral prayer for the deceased.
The preferred position in the funeral prayer is the last row, and the reason for this is that women used to mix with men during the funeral prayer.
